name: Restabilization Cog
summary: Restabilization Cogs are precision mechanical components salvaged from the leper gnomes wandering outside the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan. In Kharanos, gnomish tinkerers require these intact parts to construct the Recombobulator, an ambitious machine intended to reverse leper mutation.

sections.title: Components for a Cure
sections.body: When radiation flooded Gnomeregan in a disastrous attempt to wipe out the invading troggs, countless gnomes were twisted into sick, hostile leper gnomes. Despite their madness, these afflicted exiles still carry intricate gnomish machinery and salvageable fittings. Tinkers Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket believe the horrific transformation can be systematically undone. To finish their prototype Recombobulation Device, they rely on adventurers to recover vital parts directly from the afflicted outside Gnomeregan's gates, including intact Restabilization Cogs to balance the machine's inner combustion systems.

faq.q: What is a Restabilization Cog used for?
faq.answer: Restabilization Cogs are required by tinker Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos. Alongside Gyromechanic Gears, they serve as crucial structural pieces for building the Recombobulator, an experimental invention designed to cure irradiated leper gnomes.

faq.q: Where can these cogs be found?
faq.answer: They are carried by the maddened leper gnomes and their deranged leader Gibblewilt, who roam the exterior gates and trenches outside Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Can the Recombobulator actually cure the leper gnomes?
aliases: is there a cure for leper gnomes
faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt are confident that properly calibrated machinery can reverse the mutation. However, gnomish engineering is famously volatile, and whether the Recombobulator can truly restore their people's minds and bodies remains an ongoing and untested endeavor.

angles.text: For exiled gnomes in Dun Morogh, retrieving these components is a somber duty—stripping machinery from corrupted brethren in the desperate hope of building a cure for Gnomeregan's fallen.
The precise tolerances of Restabilization Cogs highlight classic gnomish design, built to withstand volatile friction and balance delicate mechanical assemblies like the Recombobulator.
